----- components/Tombol.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Tombol". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import styles from './Tombol.module.css';

export type TombolProps = {
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  arah?: "row" | "column";
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Tombol({ label = "Tombol", showIcon = true, arah = "row", className, style }: TombolProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${{ row: styles.tombol, column: styles.tombol2 }[arah]}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.label}>
        {label}
      </div>
      {showIcon && (
        <div className={styles.iconLucideArrowRight}>
          <svg className={styles.iconLucideArrowRightSvg} viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="100%" height="100%" aria-hidden="true" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <path d="M5 12h14" />
            <path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7" />
          </svg>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Tombol;

----- components/Kartu.tsx -----
// Generated by Lakar from component "Kartu". Import tokens.css once in your app.
import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Tombol } from './Tombol';
import styles from './Kartu.module.css';

export type KartuProps = {
  title?: string;
  body?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function Kartu({ title = "Judul", body, className, style }: KartuProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${styles.kartu}${className ? ` ${className}` : ''}`} style={style}>
      <div className={styles.judul}>
        {title}
      </div>
      <div className={styles.isi}>
        {body ?? (
          <div className={styles.deskripsi}>
            Isi bawaan
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <Tombol label="Buka" />
    </div>
  );
}

export default Kartu;
